## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code builds cleanly via `make build`.
- [ ] I have tested both **Expanded Mode** and **Compact Mode**.
- [ ] This change introduces no noticeable background CPU/battery drain.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README if appropriate.
